item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:30 HKT 20/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Typhoon Wipha will be rather close to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary on Sunday morning. It will bring frequent heavy squally showers and thunderstorms over the region. Seas will be high with swells. With Wipha departing, winds will weaken gradually in the following couple of days. However, there will still be squally showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will still be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 20/07 (Sunday)
Wind: Winds will strengthen significantly. North to northeast force 9 to 10, becoming east to southeast later.
Weather: Cloudy to overcast with frequent heavy squally showers and thunderstorms. Seas will be high with swells.
Temp range: 26 - 28 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High

Date/Month: 21/07 (Monday)
Wind: Southeast force 6 to 7 at first, up to force 8 offshore and on high ground, southeast force 5 to 6 later.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional heavy squally showers and thunderstorms. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
